articles.title: Pikachu Plush Completes 67-Day Space Station Visit
articles.summary: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days on the ISS and orbited Earth about 1,040 times. ESA's World Space Week celebration includes a traveling exhibit and Pokémon GO activities at participating museums in Europe.

articles.title: Djokovic Rallies and Sabalenka Wins at China Open
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic recovered from a set down to beat Bu Yunchaokete in Beijing. Aryna Sabalenka won her opener and spoke about being easier on herself.

articles.title: Romania's 3.1-Mile Recycled Table Sets World Record
articles.summary: A community meal at a 3.1-mile recycled table in Bucharest set a Guinness World Record and raised more than $110,000 for a new children's psychiatric hospital.
